old_caption:
The video captures a dance practice session in a spacious studio. Two dancers, both dressed in flowing black costumes, are performing a choreographed routine. The studio is well-lit with natural light streaming through large windows covered by sheer white curtains. The floor is a smooth, light-colored surface, ideal for dancing. Overhead, multiple spotlights are mounted on the ceiling, providing additional illumination.

The dancers' movements are expressive and deliberate, showcasing their skill and artistry.

caption:
The video captures a bright indoor dance studio. A full-height mirror, ceiling fixtures and stage lamps, a ballet barre, sheer curtains, and a folded blue mat frame the space. A single dancer in a dark ink-wash top and black pants stands right of center, already manipulating a large folding fan with long gradient silk streamers, her mirror reflection moving in sync to the left.

Throughout the excerpt the fan is repeatedly spread into a white disc and turned edge-on. The streamers arc overhead, drape across her head, hang vertically, or trail sideways. The fan cycles in height, held high overhead, then lowered near the waist as she bends and crouches. It is raised vertically in front and extended out to the side. A red bolster and black mat rest on the floor near the mirror.

Her posture shifts with the work, from upright with one arm raised to a forward bend. Around the later frames she turns her weight with a lifted leg. The camera stays static, the reflection confirming a single dancer mid-sequence.
